description: Correct a wrong passed or failed verdict on one check: pass the result_id from get_checklist_run and a note on what was actually true. Later runs use it as calibration and re-record any code-run script; the run's own score is unchanged. Set clear to withdraw a correction.

note.description: What was actually true on the page. Later runs read this, so be specific: where the evidence is, or what is wrong.

result_id.description: The check result to correct: `results[].result_id` from get_checklist_run.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: flag_check_verdict

kind.description: 'false_positive' (recorded as passed, should have failed) or 'false_negative' (recorded as failed, should have passed).

label.description: The correction in words: 'Should have failed' or 'Should have passed'.

note.description: What the reviewer said was actually true.

verdict_correction.description: Set when a person has flagged this verdict as wrong. `status` is what the run recorded; this is what was true. Later runs of the checklist read it as calibration.

title: Flag a wrong verdict
